### 2026-10-07 – I opened the Kicad for the first time !!! and know what CAD even is !!!!!!

**1.5h**

I opened the Kicad for the first time !!! and know what CAD even is !!!!!!
Actually i just started yesterday without even knowing the full form of PCB !!!!!!!
I am making starbie the starter project as i am just starting and  i it took me 30mins to get the schematic editor ready really unziping the the care pakage and installing it in the kicad was mess exspecially kicad !!!!!! it is just too much confusing !!!
Anyways i got it the care packaged installed and even added the nessary components 'Seeed XIAO ESP32-C3','Push Buttons','OLED Display Header','Motion Sensor Header' and 'Environment Sensor'
btw wiring was a mess i just like pressed the W key and made the wiring and created a absolute mess !!! then i had to Ctrl+Z everything !!!!
and also my bad luck i downloaded a ancient version of lookout app so my laspe did not even record !!!!!!!!!!!! so i had to write the journal !!!

### 2026-10-10 – Hi Hack club reviewers!

**3.1h**

Hi Hack club reviewers!
I am writing cuz um i forget to resume the laspe !!!(it happens :D)
Well anyways my designs had some flaws like really i work like 1.9 hr on those flaws after the lapse (which i unfortunetely paused in between) first was my buzzer was connected to a +3.3V on both the sides um well it was simple but kicad just took the privious routes too and made a mess another was a i had designed diode um upside-down um so it created a short circut too well it was really simple to a experienced cad dev
but i am a beginner so i just started CAD some days ago i was complete lost on what to do so i just used the ai for this (it is well within the %30 limit um just some %2 or something sinced it just found out the errors) and yeah another error which just made kicad a hell well really a 64nm error in my edge.cuts !!!!!!!!!!!! who would even find a 64 nanometres so i has the ai solve it too from next time i will not use ai (excluding for writing the C++ in the arduino since i don't know c++) and solve this minior problem myself it was memorable day for me at least since you know i spend like 1.9 or 2 hours on erros !!
